| # Data types and definitions {#data-types-and-definitions-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                    |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+

The following basic numeric data types are used by the CLAPI. It is recommended to use them also in the application.

  Type    Storage Space   Meaning / Range
  ------- --------------- ---------------------------------------------------------
  void    \-              No Value
  SINT    8bit            signed numeric value (-128 .. +127)
  USINT   8bit            unsigned numeric value (0 .. 255)
  UINT    8bit            unsigned numeric value (0 .. 255)
  INT     16 bit          signed numeric value (-32768 .. +32767)
  UINT    16 bit          unsigned numeric value (0 .. 65535)
  UINT    32 bit          unsigned numeric value (0 .. 4294967295)
  SINT    32 bit          signed numeric value (-2147483648 .. +2147483647)
  DINT    32 bit          signed numeric value (-2147483648 .. +2147483647)
  UDINT   32 bit          unsigned numeric value (0 .. 4294967295)
  LINT    64 bit          signed numeric value (-2\^63.. +2\^63-1)
  ULINT   64 bit          unsigned numeric value (0 .. 2\^64-1)
  REAL    32 bit          32-bit binary floating point according to IEEE 754-2008
  LREAL   64 bit          64-bit binary floating point according to IEEE 754-2008

## Data type clnvm_EcuInfo_ts {#data-type-clnvm_ecuinfo_ts .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

typedef struct clnvm_EcuInfo_t

{

   uint8 IdNr_Custom_au8\[19\];    // identifier number custom

   uint8 IdNr_BR_au8\[12\];        // identifier number BR (Bosch Rexroth)

   uint8 ChangeRev_AE_au8\[10\];   // change revision AE (Automotive Electronics)clnvm_EcuInfo_ts

   uint8 FactoryCode_au8\[2\];     // factory code

   uint8 ProdDate_au8\[3\];        // production date (yy-mm-dd)

   uint8 Eeprom_Version_u8; // EEPROM version

   uint8 Calib_u8;                // Calibration data

   uint8 Hw_Typ_au8\[2\];        //hardware type

   uint8 SerialNr_au8\[4\];        //Serial number

} clnvm_EcuInfo_ts;

## Data type clcan_Message_ts. {#data-type-clcan_message_ts. .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

typedef struct

{

 uint32 id_u32;     // identifier of the message

 uint8 format_u8;   // format which will be received, either STANDARD or EXTENDED

 uint8 numBytes_u8; // number of data bytes which will be received

 uint8 data_au8\[8\]; // data which will be received

} clcan_Message_ts;

## Data type clcan_MessageTxt_ts. {#data-type-clcan_messagetxt_ts. .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

typedef struct

{

 uint32 id_u32;      // identifier of the received message

 uint8  format_u8;   // format of the received message, either STANDARD or EXTENDED

 uint8  numBytes_u8; // number of data bytes which were received

 uint8  \*data_pu8;     // data bytes which were received

} clcan_MessageTxt_ts;

## Data type clcan_AswConfig_ts. {#data-type-clcan_aswconfig_ts. .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

typedef struct clcan_AswConfig_t

{

   uint8  channelNo_u8;                 /\* CAN channel number set by ASW \*/

   uint32 baudrate_u32;                 /\* CAN baudrate set by ASW\*/

   uint32 RxID_u32;                        /\* CAN Recieve ID set by ASW \*/

   uint32 TxID_u32;                        /\* CAN Transmit ID set by ASW \*/

} clcan_AswConfig_ts;

 

## Data type clcan_fd_AswConfig_ts. {#data-type-clcan_fd_aswconfig_ts. .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

typedef struct clcan_fd_baudrate_t

{

    uint32 nominalBaudrate_u32;             /\* nominal CAN FD baudrate \*/

    uint32 dataBaudrate_u32;                /\* data CAN FD baudrate \*/

 

 } clcan_fd_baudrate_ts;

 

/\* Structure to read CAN FD data from NVM \*/

typedef struct clcan_fd_AswConfig_t

{

   uint8  channelNo_u8;                     /\* UDS based CAN channel number stored in NVM by ASW \*/

   clcan_fd_baudrate_ts fdBaudrate_s;      /\* UDS based CAN FD baudrates stored in NVM by ASW \*/

   uint32 rxID_u32;                         /\* CAN Recieve ID stored in NVM by ASW \*/

   uint32 txID_u32;                         /\* CAN Transmit ID stored in NVM by ASW \*/

 

} clcan_fd_AswConfig_ts;

## Data type clcan_BusOffCallback_tpf. {#data-type-clcan_busoffcallback_tpf. .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

typedef void(\* clcan_BusOffCallback_tpf) (uint16 status_u16);

 

status_u16 : Reason for bus off event. Value = 0 (currently not supported).

 

Data type cluds_instance_ts;

typedef struct uds_instance_t

{

 clcan_MessageTxt_ts    rxBoxBuff_s \_\_attribute\_\_ ((aligned (4)));  // temp. buffer for rx can msg

 // raw can message data of rx buffer

 canMsg_ts           rxCanMsg_as\[rxCanBufferSize_DU8\] \_\_attribute\_\_ ((aligned (4)));

 // raw can message data of tx buffer

 canMsg_ts           txCanMsg_as\[txCanBufferSize_DU8\] \_\_attribute\_\_ ((aligned (4)));

 canMsgBuffer_ts     rxCanBuff_s \_\_attribute\_\_ ((aligned (4)));  // rx can msg buffer control

 canMsgBuffer_ts     txCanBuff_s \_\_attribute\_\_ ((aligned (4)));  // tx can msg buffer control

 cludsMsg_ts         rxKwpMsg_s \_\_attribute\_\_ ((aligned (4)));   // rx uds message buffer

 cludsMsg_ts         txKwpMsg_s \_\_attribute\_\_ ((aligned (4)));   // tx uds message buffer

 tpState_ts          tpState_s \_\_attribute\_\_ ((aligned (4)));    // transport protocol control

 cludsParam_ts       udsParam_s \_\_attribute\_\_ ((aligned (4)));   // common uds parameters

 rxCallback_tpf      rxFunc_pf;                          // function to evaluate a rx msg

 errorCallback_tpf   errorFunc_pf;                       // function to evaluate run time errors

} cluds_instance_ts;
